name: Kuze Taichi
source:
“Your body is your greatest asset.
Maybe you two should train a bit more.”

Kazuhito and Souko's childhood friend.

He's a jack of all trades in sports, but not so good at using his head.

His family runs a full-contact karate dojo in their home, where he spends his days absorbed in training.

He's manly and broad-minded, but also a bit airheaded.
